crossRefs.note: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its…
the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Ithamar
people.line: Youngest son of Aaron; served as priest.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.bsb: and he gave the Merarites four carts and eight oxen, as their service required, all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
translations.kjv: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.asv: and four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
